models_evaluated: Rule-based potassium CDSS (hard-stop blocking of prescriptions exceeding concentration, infusion rate, and daily dose limits)

links.outcome: Rate and trend of CDSS blocked prescription attempts and persistent near misses
links.effect: 38,961 of 90,741 prescriptions (42.9%) triggered blocked attempts with upward trend (β = 20.4, p < 0.001); near misses median 27.4% (IQR 17.5-32.2), suggesting alert fatigue and overreliance
links.quote: After CDSS implementation, 90,741 potassium prescriptions were submitted, of which 38,961 (42.9%) triggered CDSS blocked attempts, showing a consistent upward trend (β = 20.4, p < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Hard-stop CDSS blocking of potassium prescriptions exceeding predefined safety limits to reduce adverse drug events (potassium share of drug-related events fell from 2.8% to 0.2%, p = 0.008)
